[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

### **What We Do?**

Ametheus is a technology-driven global enterprise specializing in commodity trading, chartering,
medicine export, direct to consumer supply, trade finance, analytics, and strategy. We simplify
complex transactions, deliver end-to-end D2C logistics, and structure import finance solutions
(including LCs) for buyers and sellers worldwide.

**As a business accelerator**, we also empower our partners with strategic guidance, market access,
and operational support to accelerate their growth in global commodity markets.

### **What We Do?**

Ametheus is a technology-driven global enterprise specializing in commodity trading, chartering,
medicine export, direct to consumer supply, trade finance, analytics, and strategy. We simplify
complex transactions, deliver end-to-end D2C logistics, and structure import finance solutions
(including LCs) for buyers and sellers worldwide.

**As a business accelerator**, we also empower our partners with strategic guidance, market access,
and operational support to accelerate their growth in global commodity markets.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

## Consolidate Your Billing, Payments, and Collections All Under One Roof

## **Your All-in-One Financial Solution**

BillFlash brings **billing, payments, patient financing, and collections** together in one
affordable platform—giving healthcare providers and RCM companies everything they need to simplify
operations and accelerate cash flow.

For over 20 years, NexTrust has been **getting Providers paid with the best Customer and Payer
experiences **through our BillFlash suite of services. Our reimagined technology eliminates
administrative burden and simplifies every step of the patient financial journey.

From professionally mailed statements and same-day electronic billing via text and email to patient
financing, integrated collections, and full RCM services, **every** **BillFlash tool is designed to
minimize administrative workload and get practices paid faster.**

[ ][188]

### BillFlash solutions can increase your payments by up to 60% by making it easier for your
### customers to pay 24/7

## Build Your Perfect Lineup

With no contracts and transactional pricing, you only pay for what you use

### [ **PreBill
### Pre-Visit Billing** ][189]

With BillFlash's **PreBill** pre-visit billing, you can request payment from patients via email or
text before their scheduled appointment—helping reduce outstanding balances and ensuring your
practice gets paid faster.

It’s a simple, secure way to collect payments ahead of time, giving patients the flexibility to
settle their bills conveniently while improving your cash flow.

Start using **PreBill** today and experience a smoother, more efficient billing process.

[ Learn More ][190]

### [ **eBill Notices
### via Text & Email** ][191]

The sooner payers receive their bills, the sooner you get paid! 
Customizable **eBill Notices** allow you to send same-day notifications via text & email.

Accelerate payments by pairing the convenience of **eBill Notices** along with the reliability of
**Mailed Bills. **Fortifying your **Mailed Bills** with **eBill Notices** has been shown to decrease
the average days to payment from **2**0 to 9.

**eBill Notices** provide a convenient way for your customers to view and pay their bill online at
our payment portal, **PayWoot.com.**

[ Learn More ][192]

### [ **Mailed Bills** ][193]

Painlessly send professionally printed and customizable **Mailed Bills**. Upload, review, edit, and
approve your bills with the click of a button.

 Easily add/edit messages, specify the forms of payments you accept, and change the color of your
statements with our customizable templates. Add **Inserts** to turn your **Mailed Bills** into a
cost-effective communication channel.

Mailed statements are sent the next business day after approval, **ensuring fast delivery**.

[ Learn More ][194]

### [ **PayReminders** ][195]


Put your billing on autopilot with PayReminders pre-collection billing reminders.

Sending pre-collection billing reminders is an efficient and cost-effective way to manage your
receivables before they become past-due.

PayReminders use a seamless cadence of electronic reminders sent via email and text to motivate
customers to pay faster.

Customers are automatically removed from the sequence when payment is received. Just set it and
forget it!
[ Learn More ][196]

### [ **Payments** ][197]

**Everyone wins** when you provide
the payment options your payers & staff prefer.

Our comprehensive payment solutions allow you to accept** mobile, online, in-office,
mail, and phone payments, **with popular features such as **StoredPay**, **AutoPay**, and
**PlanPay**.

Enjoy our **merchant account **with competitive processing fees and features such as Card Account
Updater, or keep your own merchant account and use our payment gateway.

[ Learn More ][198]

### [ **FlexPay
### Patient Financing** ][199]

1 in 4 Americans can't afford a $400 unexpected bill. By offering patient financing, you can attract
new patients and empower your existing patients to receive the care they need **or** want.

**FlexPay** provides transparent patient financing, with a quick online application, no hard credit
checks to apply, no fees, and 90% approvals.

**The best part?** You get paid in full right away, without future bad-debt recourse.

vendor platform in the food and beverage industry.

designed to increase sales, while simplifying order management and fulfillment processes.
All you have to do is upload detailed product catalogs with high-quality images and descriptions.
Then, we will feature your brand in the Endless Aisle. It is that easy.

For wholesale distributors and food suppliers looking for software to manage their business,
BlueCart provides the tools you need alongside the buyer network to use them with. As a wholesaler
software platform, BlueCart combines your digital storefront, order management, inventory,
invoicing, and buyer CRM in a single system built for distribution businesses of every size.

  conversions in your market.

* ‍**Incentivize Repeat Business**: Boost initial sales by offering free delivery to first-time

  network without manual follow-up from your sales team.

  system replaces phone and email ordering with a streamlined platform that keeps your operation
  running efficiently as your buyer network grows.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How does the Endless Aisle help me reach new restaurant buyers?**

The Endless Aisle connects your catalog with restaurants actively placing orders on BlueCart. Your
products become visible to buyers in your delivery area (many of whom are looking for new local
suppliers).

**How can buyers find my products on the Endless Aisle?**

Buyers can find your products on the Endless Aisle by searching relevant keywords or browsing
categories in their market. When a new vendor goes live, buyers in the same area will oftentimes see
a pop-up highlighting your brand and logo to help drive initial visibility to your products.

**Do you have a tool to streamline all my orders?**

Yes, BlueCart has an all-inclusive order management system that enables vendors to increase sales
and better serve their customers. As a vendor using Endless Aisle, you'll automatically have access
to this must-have feature.

**Is BlueCart a wholesale management system for distributors of all sizes?**

Yes. BlueCart is used by wholesale businesses ranging from small independent distributors to large
multi-warehouse operations. The platform scales with your business, giving small distributors the
same order management, catalog, and invoicing tools as larger operations without enterprise-level
pricing or complexity. Whether you are just starting to sell wholesale online or looking to replace
a legacy wholesale management system, BlueCart can be set up and running within days.

and requires separate tools for everything else. BlueCart brings the full operation together: a
buyer-facing ecommerce storefront, per-account catalog and pricing management, order management,
inventory tracking, delivery route management, invoicing and payment collection, and a CRM for
managing buyer relationships. Everything runs in one platform, which means your data stays
consistent and your team works from a single system rather than switching between multiple tools.

Yes. You can offer local delivery, nationwide shipping, or both by setting up separate catalogs. You
can also fulfill orders using your own drivers, third-party logistics, or your preferred
distributor. BlueCart is built to fit your existing workflow.

If you have any additional questions, feel free to [book a demo][25] to see how the platform will
work for your business.

### Avapritinib

#### Approved indications: U.S. and Europe
* Adults with indolent systemic mastocytosis

## Meet the Blue Crew

## Meet the Blue Crew

### Juan Romero, Senior Director, Supply Chain International

I am responsible for ensuring our approved medicine is available in all countries where we have
marketing authorization outside the U.S. and China, either through the approved market
authorizations or our paid Named Patient Program. Collaboration with both internal and external
partners is essential to achieve this goal. Internally, I work closely with teams across Regulatory
Affairs, Commercial, Quality Assurance and Finance. Externally, I partner with packaging
specialists, customer service and logistics providers, and distributors. Together, we are committed
to delivering treatment to “Every Patient, Every Time.”

[Read on][100]

We aspire to advance the scientific understanding of disease and pioneer life-changing medicines for
patients. To learn more about our scientific leadership and perspectives, visit Our Blueprint.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

# Transforming medicines manufacturing through world-class research, training, facilities and
# translational science

[ Find out more ][107]

Transforming Medicines Development, Manufacture & Supply
* [Research]
  
  ## Research
  
  Industrially relevant research delivered by a multidisciplinary and collaborative academic team.
  
  [Visit Research][108]
* [Skills Development]
  
  ## Skills Development
  
  A vibrant world-class, multi-disciplinary PhD & MSc training programmes that will equip graduates
  with leading edge skills in pioneering continuous processes.
  
  [Visit Skills Development][109]
* [Award Winning Facilities]
  
  ## Award Winning Facilities
  
  Comprehensive suite of continuous processing, process analysis, and characterisation equipment
  housed in the Technology and Innovation Centre at Strathclyde.
  
  [Visit Facilities][110]
* [Translation to Industry]
  
  ## Translation to Industry
  
  The demand-led manufacturing research scope of the Centre was co-created with our industry
  partners. 
  
  [Visit Industry][111]

# Innovative Medicines Manufacturing

### MicroFactories and Digital Twins

CMAC’s vision to transform medicines manufacturing requires development of innovative, modular and
integrated continuous manufacturing processes for drug substance and drug product.

End-to-end modular lab scale microfactories are being developed to meet this need, with immersive
augmented reality and virtual reality solutions providing exciting tools that enable sustainable
development of ready to use technologies.

# translational science

[ Find out more ][107]

Transforming Medicines Development, Manufacture & Supply
* [Research]
  
  ## Research
  
  Industrially relevant research delivered by a multidisciplinary and collaborative academic team.
  
  [Visit Research][108]
* [Skills Development]
  
  ## Skills Development
  
  A vibrant world-class, multi-disciplinary PhD & MSc training programmes that will equip graduates
  with leading edge skills in pioneering continuous processes.
  
  [Visit Skills Development][109]
* [Award Winning Facilities]
  
  ## Award Winning Facilities
  
  Comprehensive suite of continuous processing, process analysis, and characterisation equipment
  housed in the Technology and Innovation Centre at Strathclyde.
  
  [Visit Facilities][110]
* [Translation to Industry]
  
  ## Translation to Industry
  
  The demand-led manufacturing research scope of the Centre was co-created with our industry
  partners. 
  
  [Visit Industry][111]

# Innovative Medicines Manufacturing

### MicroFactories and Digital Twins

CMAC’s vision to transform medicines manufacturing requires development of innovative, modular and
integrated continuous manufacturing processes for drug substance and drug product.

End-to-end modular lab scale microfactories are being developed to meet this need, with immersive
augmented reality and virtual reality solutions providing exciting tools that enable sustainable
development of ready to use technologies.

[ Find out more ][112]

## We lead the NHS in England to deliver high quality services for all

If you are looking for information about health conditions and NHS services please visit
[NHS.uk][16].

[My Planned Care][17] gives you advice and support while you wait and helps you to prepare for your
hospital consultation, treatment, or surgery.

[NHS league tables][18] provide a view of how NHS trusts are performing in key services including
urgent and emergency care, elective services, mental health and more.

[[Doctor examining a patient]][19]

## [The best of the NHS][20]

Every day, NHS colleagues across the country are delivering outstanding care in new and innovative
ways. Discover some of the [best work happening in the NHS][21] right now.

[[A nurse stands by a hospital bed talking to a patient]][22]

## [Medium Term Planning Framework - delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][23]

The [Medium Term Planning Framework – delivering change together 2026/27 to 2028/29][24] is the
NHS’s most ambitious plan in a generation, setting out how waiting times will be dramatically
reduced and local care restored over the next 3 years while resetting the foundations to deliver the
10 Year Health Plan.

### [Digital transformation][25]

Helping health and care professionals communicate better.

### [Elective care][26]

How we are improving experience and giving people choice and control for elective care services.

### [Workforce][27]

How we can put the NHS workforce on a sustainable footing and meet future challenges.

### [Mental health][28]

Improving outcomes and experiences of people with mental health problems.

### [Integrated care][29]

Giving people the support they need and removing disjointed care.

### [Cancer][30]

Making sure everyone with cancer receives care, support and treatment.

### [Urgent and emergency care][31]

Ensuring patients get the right care whenever they need it.

### [Primary care][32]

Offering patients a wider choice of personalised health services.

### [Health inequalities improvement][33]

Tackling health inequalities and advancing equality and diversity across the NHS.

### [NHS IMPACT][34]

Delivering continuous improvement across the NHS.

### [NHS @home][35]

Providing better connected, more personalised care in homes and care homes.

## boundaries of innovation

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

Our strategic focus spans the pivotal therapeutic areas of Oncology, Dermatology, and Respiratory.
By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely
positioned to deliver our products reliably, responsibly, and sustainably supporting patients,
healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

Cephalosporins, Carbapenems, Liquid Injectables, Pencililin Injections, Eye/Ear/ Nasal Drops and

fulfill client expectations and contribute to the welfare of the society.

pharmaceutical industry. Make the lives of human beings and animal safe and healthy by delivering
our quality formulations of eye drops and injection ranges around the Globe.

based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves

orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Hola Health?

Hola Health is a secure on-demand telehealth provider in Australia. Available all year round, Hola
Health connects you with AHPRA-registered doctors or medical practitioners for online medical
certificates, instant scripts or new prescriptions (where clinically appropriate), specialist
referrals, and general consultations typically within 15 minutes (Based on typical wait times; may
vary by demand and practitioner availability). Access bulk billing doctor consults after hours for
urgent medical advice available for eligible Medicare cardholders.

### Is Hola Health safe?

Hola Health operates within Australian clinical and privacy standards. As with all healthcare
services, individual outcomes depend on clinical assessment. We prioritise the privacy of your data.
All patient information is stored on highly secure, encrypted servers hosted within the Australian
Data Centre, conformant to ISO 27001 standards. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using
enterprise-grade encryption protocols. Hola Health is an [Australian Digital Health
Agency-registered platform][105], which means we follow strict privacy guidelines under the
[**Australian Privacy Principles**][10

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Hola Health?

Hola Health is a secure on-demand telehealth provider in Australia. Available all year round, Hola
Health connects you with AHPRA-registered doctors or medical practitioners for online medical
certificates, instant scripts or new prescriptions (where clinically appropriate), specialist
referrals, and general consultations typically within 15 minutes (Based on typical wait times; may
vary by demand and practitioner availability). Access bulk billing doctor consults after hours for
urgent medical advice available for eligible Medicare cardholders.

### Is Hola Health safe?

Hola Health operates within Australian clinical and privacy standards. As with all healthcare
services, individual outcomes depend on clinical assessment. We prioritise the privacy of your data.
All patient information is stored on highly secure, encrypted servers hosted within the Australian
Data Centre, conformant to ISO 27001 standards. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit using
enterprise-grade encryption protocols. Hola Health is an [Australian Digital Health
Agency-registered platform][105], which means we follow strict privacy guidelines under the
[**Australian Privacy Principles**][10

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

# Our Impact

# 42M+

Units Shipped Worldwide

[Inven founders]

Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

00:00-00:02
[White background with red Lilly logo appears.]

00:03-00:12
[Mary and Peggy are sitting on a tan couch in their living room. They are both wearing sweatshirts
and are seated comfortably with their hands on top of their laps. Mary is seated with her legs
crossed. After we are introduced to Mary, a montage of old photos begins to play: the first photo is
of Mary in a white dress outside with a gentleman in the background wearing a tie; the second photo
is of Mary’s mother and father at a dining table.]

**Caption**: Mary

**Mary: My** **mother** **had** **Alzheimer's** **disease.** **At** **that** **point** **in**
**time,** **I** **didn't** **know** **that** **that** **was** **going** **to** **be** **me**
**someday.** **But** **I** **kind** **of** **thought** **maybe** **someday it might.** **And**
**I'm** **glad** **that** **I** **went** **through** **it** **with** **her,** **because** **I**
**know** **what** **to** **expect.**

00:13-00:24
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch. A montage with photos of them together
begins to play; the first photo is of Mary and Peggy sitting in doors together; the second photo is
of them standing outside together in summer clothing; the third photo is of them sitting in a
restaurant booth, with Mary leaning her head on Peggy’s shoulder; the fourth photo is of them at a
high-top table in a bar.]

**Caption**: Peggy

**Peggy: We** **have** **been** **married** **since** **2014.** **We** **have** **been**
**together** **for 30 years.** **I** **chased** **her** **for** **six** **months.** **Then** **she**
**finally** **realized** **that** **it's** **all** **good.**

**Mary: “She’s serious.”**

00:24-00:38
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: I** **worked** **for** the **Department of** **Natural** **Resources**, **and** **so** **I**
**traveled** **the** **state** **a** **lot. Well, I** **got** **to** **the** **point** **where**
**I** **couldn't** **remember** **which** **road** **to** **take.** **Finding** **errors** **that**
**I** **normally** **wouldn't** **have** **made** **that** **were** **so** **simple** **and** **so**
**easy.**

00:38-00:57
[A photo of Mary at a doctor’s office, completing a cognitive assessment appears. The scene then
cuts back to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: When** **I** **was** **diagnosed** **with** **Alzheimer's,** **it** **was** **kind** **of**
**a** **shock but** **we** **knew** **something** **was** **wrong.** **I** **didn't** **know**
**what** **was** **going** **on** **in** **my** **brain.** **Why** **I** **was** **forgetting**
**everything,** **losing** **everything.** **Uh,** **wallets,** **money.**

**Peggy:** **Her** **wedding** **ring,** **she** **would** **just** **take** **off** **and**
**forget.** **Lost** **four** **of** **those,** **now** **she** **wears** **it** **around** **her**
**neck.**

00:57-01:16
[Footage plays of Mary and Peggy sitting in a bench on their porch with their dog in the background
before cutting back to them on their couch.]

**
Mary: I** **was** **relieved** **to** **know** **that** **there** **was** **something—that** **I**
**was** **diagnosed,** **because** **we** **knew** **that** **I** **was** **having** **issues.**

**Peggy: There** **was** **some** **depression** **there** **too, I think.**

**Mary: Oh** **yeah,** **there** **was** **some** **depression.**

**Peggy:** ‘**Cause**, **I** **mean,** **that** **that's** **not** **the** **best** **scenario**
**that** **you** **really** **want. But** **she** **was,** **I** **guess**, **almost** **relieved**
**that** **now** **she** **knows,** “**this** **is** **why** **I'm** **doing** **this.**”

01:17-01:34
[Footage of Mary and Peggy having a conversation in their kitchen plays, followed by clips of Mary
walking their dog on the sidewalk in her neighborhood, completing a puzzle at her kitchen table with
Peggy watching, and a gathering with their friends in the outdoor seating section at a restaurant.
After all of the footage plays, two photos of Mary and Peggy appear: the first is of them in summer
clothing with the ocean in the background; the second is of them outside on a promenade.]

**Mary: So** **far,** **it's** **been** **okay.** **I** **seem** **to** **be** **maintaining**
**fairly** **well,** **which** **is** **makes** **me** **happy.** **I** **don't** **know** **if**
**it's** **because** **I'm** **active,** **I** **walk.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of**
**reading.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of** **puzzles.**

**Peggy: Twice** **a** **month** **we'll** **meet** **friends** **for** **lunch.** **In**
**February,** **we** **went** **to** **Florida** **and** **just** **to** **get** **away.**

01:35-01:47
[The scene cuts back to Mary on her couch, then footage of her lying down on the couch playing games

**Caption**: Mary

**Mary: My** **mother** **had** **Alzheimer's** **disease.** **At** **that** **point** **in**
**time,** **I** **didn't** **know** **that** **that** **was** **going** **to** **be** **me**
**someday.** **But** **I** **kind** **of** **thought** **maybe** **someday it might.** **And**
**I'm** **glad** **that** **I** **went** **through** **it** **with** **her,** **because** **I**
**know** **what** **to** **expect.**

00:13-00:24
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch. A montage with photos of them together
begins to play; the first photo is of Mary and Peggy sitting in doors together; the second photo is
of them standing outside together in summer clothing; the third photo is of them sitting in a
restaurant booth, with Mary leaning her head on Peggy’s shoulder; the fourth photo is of them at a
high-top table in a bar.]

**Caption**: Peggy

**Peggy: We** **have** **been** **married** **since** **2014.** **We** **have** **been**
**together** **for 30 years.** **I** **chased** **her** **for** **six** **months.** **Then** **she**
**finally** **realized** **that** **it's** **all** **good.**

**Mary: “She’s serious.”**

00:24-00:38
[The scene then returns to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: I** **worked** **for** the **Department of** **Natural** **Resources**, **and** **so** **I**
**traveled** **the** **state** **a** **lot. Well, I** **got** **to** **the** **point** **where**
**I** **couldn't** **remember** **which** **road** **to** **take.** **Finding** **errors** **that**
**I** **normally** **wouldn't** **have** **made** **that** **were** **so** **simple** **and** **so**
**easy.**

00:38-00:57
[A photo of Mary at a doctor’s office, completing a cognitive assessment appears. The scene then
cuts back to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: When** **I** **was** **diagnosed** **with** **Alzheimer's,** **it** **was** **kind** **of**
**a** **shock but** **we** **knew** **something** **was** **wrong.** **I** **didn't** **know**
**what** **was** **going** **on** **in** **my** **brain.** **Why** **I** **was** **forgetting**
**everything,** **losing** **everything.** **Uh,** **wallets,** **money.**

**Peggy:** **Her** **wedding** **ring,** **she** **would** **just** **take** **off** **and**
**forget.** **Lost** **four** **of** **those,** **now** **she** **wears** **it** **around** **her**
**neck.**

00:57-01:16
[Footage plays of Mary and Peggy sitting in a bench on their porch with their dog in the background
before cutting back to them on their couch.]

**
Mary: I** **was** **relieved** **to** **know** **that** **there** **was** **something—that** **I**
**was** **diagnosed,** **because** **we** **knew** **that** **I** **was** **having** **issues.**

**Peggy: There** **was** **some** **depression** **there** **too, I think.**

**Mary: Oh** **yeah,** **there** **was** **some** **depression.**

**Peggy:** ‘**Cause**, **I** **mean,** **that** **that's** **not** **the** **best** **scenario**
**that** **you** **really** **want. But** **she** **was,** **I** **guess**, **almost** **relieved**
**that** **now** **she** **knows,** “**this** **is** **why** **I'm** **doing** **this.**”

01:17-01:34
[Footage of Mary and Peggy having a conversation in their kitchen plays, followed by clips of Mary
walking their dog on the sidewalk in her neighborhood, completing a puzzle at her kitchen table with
Peggy watching, and a gathering with their friends in the outdoor seating section at a restaurant.
After all of the footage plays, two photos of Mary and Peggy appear: the first is of them in summer
clothing with the ocean in the background; the second is of them outside on a promenade.]

**Mary: So** **far,** **it's** **been** **okay.** **I** **seem** **to** **be** **maintaining**
**fairly** **well,** **which** **is** **makes** **me** **happy.** **I** **don't** **know** **if**
**it's** **because** **I'm** **active,** **I** **walk.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of**
**reading.** **I** **do** **a** **lot** **of** **puzzles.**

**Peggy: Twice** **a** **month** **we'll** **meet** **friends** **for** **lunch.** **In**
**February,** **we** **went** **to** **Florida** **and** **just** **to** **get** **away.**

01:35-01:47
[The scene cuts back to Mary on her couch, then footage of her lying down on the couch playing games
on her phone.]

**Mary: If** **I** **could** **slow** **down** **the** **progression,** **I** **would.** **I**
**think** **I've** **tried** **to** **do** **as** **much** **as** **I** **can** **do** **to**
**make** **it** **slow** **down.** **Advice** **I** **can** **give** **other** **people** **who**
**have** **it? Find** **it** **while** **it's** **still** **early,** **while** **they** **can**
**do** **something** **more** **with** **it.**

01:47-02:06
[A photo of Mary sitting with her dog on the couch appears, followed by photos of Mary standing next
to an ocean and Mary sitting on a boat. The scene then cuts back to Mary and Peggy on their couch.]

**Mary: It's** **a** **depressing** **thing,** **and** **it's** **something** **that** **you**
**don't** **want** **to** **accept** **in** **your** **life,** **but** **you** **need** **to**
**tackle** **it** **and** **get** **a** **grip** **on** **it** **early.** **I** **know** **I'm**
**declining** **because** **my** **wife** **tells** **me** **I** **am declining** **all** **the**
**time! But** **I** **know** **that's** **going** **to** **happen.** **I'm** **going** **to** **be**
**grateful** **for** **what** **I** **get.**

**Peggy: For** **as** **much** **time** **as...**

**Mary:** **Time** **as** **I** **get,** **yeah.**

02:06-02:08
[Scene cuts to Peggy and Mary standing together in their home laughing.]

**Mary: As** **much** **as** **I** **can** **remember, for** **as** **long** **as** **I** **can**
**get.**

## The Lupin Story

Driven by Science,
Inspired by Patients

Founded by Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta in 1968,
Lupin aimed to improve access to essential
medicines. Today we stand tall as a globally
trusted pharmaceutical company guided by
science, quality, and a patient-first mindset.

[
Know More
][105]

## Our Purpose

We Catalyze
Treatments
That Transform
Hope Into
Healing

Ours is a purpose-driven
journey of over 5 decades,
where we aim to improve
lives, build sustainability
and deliver long-term
solutions to all.

Relief from disease

Delivering meaningful
treatments for today and
tomorrow

Innovation to unlock access at scale

Making complex, cutting-edge
healthcare solutions accessible
to all

[Know More][106]
Solutions for underserved communities

Serving markets and patients
overlooked by others

Lupin operates a highly diversified pharmaceutical business with a
strong presence across key global markets. Our operations span
generics, complex formulations,
branded products, and other
high-burden specialty segments, supported by robust R&D
and manufacturing capabilities.
Spread across developed and emerging markets, Lupin's business is anchored in patient-centric
approach and operational excellence.

Our Promise
Leave no citizen behind in the
journey towards a healthier nation.
[quality] Quality
Our non-compromising approach to quality ensures that we are constantly endeavoring to achieve and
maintain the highest quality standards in the pharmaceutical industry in India.
[affordability] Affordability
Staying true to our founding principles of being a price disruptor, we deliver affordable medication
that meets the healthcare needs of Bharat.
[accessibility] Accessibility
More than 50% of India’s total population resides in villages, making access to medicines difficult.
Mankind’s pioneering use of supply chains and a company-owned distribution setup bolsters
accessibility.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

##### **medicostores.com**

Medicostores.com is a B2B pharma marketplace connecting stockists, retailers, and manufacturers.
[Read More...][12]


##### **Medico Local App**

Medico LocalApp connects you to local pharmacies for easy medicine delivery to your doorstep. [Read
More...][13]


##### **Medico ERP**

Medico ERP software streamlines inventory and finances for pharma retailers. [Read More...][14]


##### **Medico Delivery App**

Medico Delivery App streamlines medicine orders from stockists to retailers with timely deliveries.
[Read More...][15]


##### **E-Invoicing and GST**

Seamless E-Invoicing & GST Integration Services by Medicostores. [Read More...][16]


### How does medicostores.com stand out?

## **B2B Marketplace**

medicostores.com is transforming the pharma industry into a clear and easy-to-use online market for
pharmacies and distributors. It simplifies buying and selling medicine supplies, offering up-to-date
product information and fair pricing. This not only builds trust but also encourages better buying
choices, making the market competitive and beneficial for everyone involved. By digitizing B2B
sales, it creates a space where distributors and pharmacies can grow their business together
effectively.


## **GEO Location Search**

medicostores.com leverages GEO location technology to provide results based on the user's specific
location. This feature enables pharmacies and distributors to find each other more efficiently,
ensuring that the supply chain is optimized for local demand. By incorporating geolocation,
Medicostores enhances the relevance and speed of service delivery, making it easier for users to
connect with nearby suppliers, reducing lead times, and improving the overall procurement process.




## **SaaS Software**

medicostores.com is a SaaS platform in the healthcare sector, employing AI and Machine Learning to
optimize pharmacy and distributor interactions. These technologies enable predictive analytics,
streamlined inventory management, and personalized service, enhancing operational efficiency. This
approach not only simplifies procurement processes but also ensures that stakeholders have the tools
to provide better healthcare services, making medicostores.com a leader in digital health solutions.


## **Custom Promotions**

On medicostores.com, stockists can create custom promotions targeted at specific user groups,
enhancing sales potential. This feature allows for personalized marketing, enabling stockists to
offer deals directly to pharmacies, thus driving demand and increasing purchase rates. It's a
strategic tool that not only boosts sales but also strengthens relationships between stockists and
their customers by providing value added offers tailored to their needs.




## **UPI /Memo 2 Payment Service**

Medicostores is advancing the pharmaceutical sector with UPI payments, ensuring fast and secure
cashless transactions. Stockists can generate dynamic QR codes with fixed amounts for retailers,
simplifying the payment process and ensuring precise, hassle-free financial exchanges. This system
not only streamlines financial operations but also supports the digitalization trend in India's
financial landscape, making Medicostores a key player in modernizing pharmaceutical transactions.

## **Delivery As Service**

Medicostores is enhancing its offerings with Medico Delivery, a specialized service crafted for
stockists and retailers. This initiative aims to streamline the distribution of medical supplies and
pharmaceutical products, ensuring fast and efficient deliveries directly from stockists to retailers
or end consumers. Medico Delivery encompasses a suite of features designed to optimize logistics,
including flexible delivery options like same-day and next-day service, real time tracking for
shipment transparency, cost-effective solutions to reduce transportation costs, and seamless
integration with Medicostores platforms for improved operational efficiency and user experience.

Medicostores.com is a B2B pharma marketplace connecting stockists, retailers, and manufacturers.

##### **Medico Local App**

Medico LocalApp connects you to local pharmacies for easy medicine delivery to your doorstep. [Read

##### **Medico ERP**

Medico ERP software streamlines inventory and finances for pharma retailers. [Read More...][14]


##### **Medico Delivery App**

Medico Delivery App streamlines medicine orders from stockists to retailers with timely deliveries.
[Read More...][15]


##### **E-Invoicing and GST**

Seamless E-Invoicing & GST Integration Services by Medicostores. [Read More...][16]


### How does medicostores.com stand out?

## **B2B Marketplace**

medicostores.com is transforming the pharma industry into a clear and easy-to-use online market for
pharmacies and distributors. It simplifies buying and selling medicine supplies, offering up-to-date
product information and fair pricing. This not only builds trust but also encourages better buying
choices, making the market competitive and beneficial for everyone involved. By digitizing B2B
sales, it creates a space where distributors and pharmacies can grow their business together
effectively.


## **GEO Location Search**

medicostores.com leverages GEO location technology to provide results based on the user's specific
location. This feature enables pharmacies and distributors to find each other more efficiently,
ensuring that the supply chain is optimized for local demand. By incorporating geolocation,
Medicostores enhances the relevance and speed of service delivery, making it easier for users to
connect with nearby suppliers, reducing lead times, and improving the overall procurement process.




## **SaaS Software**

medicostores.com is a SaaS platform in the healthcare sector, employing AI and Machine Learning to
optimize pharmacy and distributor interactions. These technologies enable predictive analytics,
streamlined inventory management, and personalized service, enhancing operational efficiency. This
approach not only simplifies procurement processes but also ensures that stakeholders have the tools
to provide better healthcare services, making medicostores.com a leader in digital health solutions.


## **Custom Promotions**

On medicostores.com, stockists can create custom promotions targeted at specific user groups,
enhancing sales potential. This feature allows for personalized marketing, enabling stockists to
offer deals directly to pharmacies, thus driving demand and increasing purchase rates. It's a
strategic tool that not only boosts sales but also strengthens relationships between stockists and
their customers by providing value added offers tailored to their needs.




## **UPI /Memo 2 Payment Service**

Medicostores is advancing the pharmaceutical sector with UPI payments, ensuring fast and secure
cashless transactions. Stockists can generate dynamic QR codes with fixed amounts for retailers,
simplifying the payment process and ensuring precise, hassle-free financial exchanges. This system
not only streamlines financial operations but also supports the digitalization trend in India's
financial landscape, making Medicostores a key player in modernizing pharmaceutical transactions.

## **Delivery As Service**

Medicostores is enhancing its offerings with Medico Delivery, a specialized service crafted for
stockists and retailers. This initiative aims to streamline the distribution of medical supplies and
pharmaceutical products, ensuring fast and efficient deliveries directly from stockists to retailers
or end consumers. Medico Delivery encompasses a suite of features designed to optimize logistics,
including flexible delivery options like same-day and next-day service, real time tracking for
shipment transparency, cost-effective solutions to reduce transportation costs, and seamless
integration with Medicostores platforms for improved operational efficiency and user experience.

# Neon Healthcare

Improving patient access to essential medicines across worldwide markets

[Neon Healthcare foreground][Neon Healthcare background]

## Delivering Value

Neon Healthcare partners with hospitals, pharmacies, dispensing practices and other healthcare
providers to support reliable access to essential prescription medicines.

We supply a portfolio of prescription-only medicines, manufactured under rigorous quality standards
around the world and delivered through trusted distribution partners to healthcare systems in the
markets where we operate.

[The right medicine, to the right place and at the right time.]

## The right medicine, to the right place and at the right time.

We operate with a strong culture of accountability and compliance, ensuring our medicines meet
rigorous quality standards and reach patients efficiently through compliant supply pathways. We
uphold Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and work with trusted partners to ensure Good Distribution
Practice (GDP) across our markets.

[About Us][11]
[An international pharmaceutical company]

## An international pharmaceutical company

With deep expertise across pharmaceutical development, compliance, supply, and commercialisation, we
support the requirements of our own products and those of our partners—delivering sustainable access
to medicines in the markets we serve.

[Our Products][12]

## We’re results focused

We know what it takes to ensure the success of your product

  of brands and generics
* [Distribution]
  
  ### Distribution

* [Medicines]
  
  ### Medicines
  
  Tablets, capsules, creams,
  lotions, oral liquids, injectables

# Neon Healthcare

Improving patient access to essential medicines across worldwide markets

[Neon Healthcare foreground][Neon Healthcare background]

## Delivering Value

Neon Healthcare partners with hospitals, pharmacies, dispensing practices and other healthcare
providers to support reliable access to essential prescription medicines.

We supply a portfolio of prescription-only medicines, manufactured under rigorous quality standards
around the world and delivered through trusted distribution partners to healthcare systems in the
markets where we operate.

[The right medicine, to the right place and at the right time.]

## The right medicine, to the right place and at the right time.

We operate with a strong culture of accountability and compliance, ensuring our medicines meet
rigorous quality standards and reach patients efficiently through compliant supply pathways. We
uphold Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and work with trusted partners to ensure Good Distribution
Practice (GDP) across our markets.

[About Us][11]
[An international pharmaceutical company]

## An international pharmaceutical company

With deep expertise across pharmaceutical development, compliance, supply, and commercialisation, we
support the requirements of our own products and those of our partners—delivering sustainable access
to medicines in the markets we serve.

# An independent watchdog dedicated to consumer health protection

Since 1976, we have built a reputation as a trustworthy and truly independent voice for both
consumers and health professionals. We stand up for the consumer by serving as a watchdog of the
medical and pharmaceutical industries, including the FDA itself.

We are accountable only to *you*, the public, and *not* to any outside organization.

Learn more about our organization, mission, experience and credentials.

# Breaking health news & in-depth drug information you won't find anywhere else

On top of the trends and ahead of the curve, our research will keep you and your family informed as
to your best options for staying healthy.

### Crucial News Alerts

Count on us to keep you abreast of significant health information - months, years or even decades
before mainstream medicine.

[Get breaking health alerts][26]

### Deep Dive Research

We dig deep into the medical literature to see what the research reveals about actual benefits, side
effects and potential interactions of medications.

[Learn more about our work][27]

### Evidence-Based Analysis

Long before endocrine disruptors, celiac disease and generic drug quality problems were headline
news, our listeners and readers were already well informed.

[View our Press page][28]

# Going beyond the medicine cabinet with a community of like-minded health seekers

More and more people are quickly becoming aware of the idea that sometimes a doctor visit is not the
only (or sometimes even the best) option for dealing with common health issues.

Our expertise with home remedies and dietary supplements is simply unparalleled, and we have written
thousands of articles and more than a dozen books on these topics.

Leading researchers regularly come to The People’s Pharmacy to shed light on the science behind
alternative medicine. You have come to the right place to take control of your health!

people can live healthier, longer lives.

## All types of plans for all types of people

### [Health insurance plans][13]

Explore a range of individual and family plan options, including ACA Marketplace plans.

### [Medicare plans][14]

Find coverage that goes beyond Original Medicare, including Medicare Advantage plans.

### [Medicaid plans][15]

See Medicaid plan options if you have low income or qualify due to a special circumstance.

### [Dental, vision and supplemental plans][16]

Browse plans that can help you get coverage for medical costs not covered by your medical plan.

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location

# From first taste to best seller.

CORE lives in the real world: hot kitchens, loud docks, grease on your sleeves. We connect food,
beverage, and non-food brands to the people who decide what gets cooked, stocked, and reordered.
Straight talk. Products that move.

We don’t chase trends. We set them.

[ Let’s Get To Work ][32]
[Customer using a touchscreen kiosk to place an order] [Foodservice professional placing a sandwich
in a commercial oven]

WHERE WE SELL

## Where foodservice happens.

From national chains to independent restaurants, this business runs on access. We build demand with
the people who decide what lands on menus and behind the bar.
* Close ties with buyers nationwide
* Field reps with real pull in local markets
* A seat at the table where purchasing decisions happen

[Chicken wings encircled by a graphic ring]
[ Regional & National Restaurant Chains ][36] [ Non-Commercial ][37] [ K-12 Schools ][38] [
Corporate Distribution ][39] [ Independent Restaurants ][40] [ Convenience Stores ][41] [ Military
][42] [ International ][43]

Don’t just take our word for it

“We had 40 brokers, and we went to one. They know their customers and their market better than
anybody else. CORE has been a change driver, and it's helped us win.”

Al Adams HERSHEY Foodservice

“They've been a great partner. Not just being able to bounce ideas off but really helping us figure
out where we need to be focused.”

Joel Kline Nestlé Professional Solutions

“They've built a great team from top to bottom. I really don't like the word food broker, they're
our partner. They have a wider extension into the market than we do, so we can win together.”

Greg Board Ken’s Foods

# Empowering Health, Inspiring Joy

Enabling Individuals to Take Control of their Well-being with Intelligent Healthcare Tools.

## **Zepp Health is committed to delivering cutting-edge smart wearable healthcare solutions that go
## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.

# Our Impact

# 42M+

Active Users in 90+ Countries

# **200M+**

Units Shipped Worldwide

# 25+

World-Class Research Partners

# 135,000+

Suspected Atrial Fibrillation Events Detected

## beyond necessity, to inspire and bring joy to our users.**

# A World-Leading Health & Fitness Ecosystem

We empower users to live their healthiest lives by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness
journeys through our cutting-edge smart watches, bands, hearables and soundscape service.

# With You Every Moment

Our proprietary Zepp Digital Health Management Platform, which includes the Zepp OS, AI chips,
biometric sensors, and data algorithms, delivers cloud-based 24/7 actionable insights and guidance
to help users attain their wellness goals.

# Putting the Control Back
# into the Hands of Users

By developing intelligent healthcare tools and utilizing generative AI solutions, we put the control
of well-being back into hands of users, so they can understand their data and take steps to engage
in the preventative care they need.

# Intelligent
# Healthcare Tools

Our smart wearables - including smart watches and bands capable of 24/7 health monitoring, and smart
hearing solutions which leverage the expertise of leading audiologists - put health at the center of
everything, to deliver personalized and advanced wellness support that's accessible to all.

# Generative AI Solutions

Along with AI-powered sports and sleep coaching algorithms which adjust based on the user's
real-time physiological data, our intelligent tools also use Large Language Model (LLM) in order to
recognize natural language descriptions, for human-like interactions.
